scope: Story-scoped runnable evaluation commands; scenario identifiers are local to each story.

7775.scope: Owned local PostgreSQL 16 fixtures; no live service, inference or dispatch.
7775.environment: For local tests set AWS_CONFIG_FILE=/dev/null AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE=/dev/null AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED=true. The pg_url fixture creates and drops owned databases.
7775.limitations: Commands run in modules/gateway. Parser and index tests require Python 3.12 dev dependencies. PostgreSQL skips are not acceptance; live rollout remains with story 7777. JUnit properties retain comparative synthetic plans and parser timings when an operator supplies a private --junitxml destination.

7772.limitations: PostgreSQL selectors use the Python 3.12 pg_url fixture by default. ADP_TEST_POSTGRES_URL may instead select an already authorized isolated PostgreSQL database with CREATE SCHEMA rights. Each fixture applies the projection migration and drops only its own temporary schema. Local SQLite WAL and mocked setup checks do not establish PostgreSQL acceptance.

7774.scope: Local frontend fixtures only; no backend, cloud resources, dispatch or live acceptance.
7774.prerequisites: Run npm ci --include=dev in modules/gateway/frontend. The test host must have Playwright Chromium and its OS libraries/fonts; the existing flow-read.config.ts starts a local preview server.

cases.assertions: Core graph and controls render before held activity; collapsed stories do not request activity, and expanded story batches have at most 20 IDs.
Navigation aborts old requests, workspace or attempt changes cannot display stale activity, and same-flow refresh keeps the graph visible.
Activity errors stay local without automatic retries or false completion; an explicit retry requeues once, and absent/true legacy markers use the enriched core response without extra calls.

7773.environment: Inert SQLite and mocked activity provider; disable EC2 metadata discovery and set AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY to nonfunctional test values in the shell. No deployed target, inference, or dispatch is required.
7773.command_prefix: AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED=true AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test uv run --frozen --project modules/gateway --extra dev pytest -q

cases.assertions: Core skips provider reads, preserves graph and run identity, and legacy default remains enriched.
At most four worker calls, at most 20 pages including empty pages, cancellation drains without new calls, and 20 mixed HTTP items finish within 5.5 seconds.
Only tenant-authorized current-attempt runs appear; invalid or incomplete selections start no provider calls.

7773.vitest_owner: UI adoption #7774; no Vitest selector belongs to this backend story.
7773.playwright_owner: Browser fixture and runner #7776; live verification #7777. Not a pre-merge backend assertion.
